newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to hold six-year JGB auction on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: MOF to hold six-year JGB auction on Tuesday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is planning to offer six-year Japanese government bonds through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, a MOF official said on Monday.
Traders said the issue amount is likely to be around 500 billion yen, unchanged from the previous six-year JGB auction held in January.

Judging from current market conditions, the coupon rate is likely to be set at around 1.5 or 1.6 percent, down from 1.7 percent in the previous auction, a trader for a major brokerage house said.--Tokyo Treasury Desk, +81-3-5473-3748
